What if you could manage your team, track business activities, and generate sales reports using an AI agent connected to WhatsApp? 

In this video, I'll demonstrate a practical AI automation use case that combines WhatsApp team management, sales reporting, secure data handling, and browser-based AI automation.

Instead of manually checking multiple dashboards and collecting business updates, imagine having an AI assistant that helps you organize information, execute supported workflows, and generate useful reports.

WhatsApp AI Team Management

Imagine managing a team where daily updates, tasks, and business information are communicated through WhatsApp.

With an appropriately configured AI agent and authorized integrations, you can build workflows that help organize updates, summarize activities, and assist with team coordination.

This can be useful for small businesses, startups, agencies, and remote teams.

AI-Powered Sales Reporting

Sales reporting often requires collecting information from multiple sources, analyzing performance, and preparing summaries.

AI agents can assist with retrieving authorized business data, analyzing sales trends, and generating reports.

We'll explore how these capabilities can be connected to a dashboard for easier business monitoring.

Vault, Sandbox & Browser Automation

One of the interesting aspects of modern AI agent systems is their ability to work with isolated execution environments.

In this tutorial, we'll explore:

• Vault-based credential and secret management

• Sandboxed execution environments

• Browser-based AI task execution

• Agent tool integrations

• Secure workflow configuration

• How agents process requests and return results

A sandbox can help isolate agent activity, but it does not automatically guarantee complete security. Always review permissions and protect sensitive business data.

Why This Matters

AI automation is no longer limited to simple chatbots.

With the right tools, integrations, and permissions, AI agents can help businesses reduce repetitive administrative work and improve access to operational information.

Whether you're building AI solutions for your own company or exploring AI automation services for clients, this tutorial provides a practical example of what is possible.

videos.title: Relationship Therapist: The Hidden Question Behind Every Small Argument You Have | Esther Perel
videos.description:
Most fights in a relationship aren't about the dishes. They're about the fear of losing each other, or of losing yourself.

In this episode, Esther Perel and Jay Shetty talk about why, in so many couples, one partner is more afraid of losing the other and the other is more afraid of losing themselves. Esther explains why most power struggles in a relationship are not really about power at all.

Jay shares how a small disagreement over when to do the dishes turned into "you don't appreciate me," and how he once turned his wife's tough day into a competition over whose week was harder. Esther tells the story of a fight with her husband in the car after almost 40 years of marriage, and what it showed her about blaming a partner when you feel helpless.

They also talk about the craving after a breakup, how to trust your own judgment again after a betrayal, and the stages couples go through to rebuild trust after an affair.

Learn why the need to win every argument is so often fear in disguise. And learn the small shift that makes your partner feel like part of your story instead of on hold.

videos.title: HILARY DUFF: The Hardest Relationships Are With Your Own Family
videos.description:
Hilary Duff on the family truth she spent years tiptoeing around.

In this episode, Hilary Duff and Jay Shetty talk about the songs on her first album in over a decade, and the real life behind them. She explains why, as painful as it is to share, she could only write about what she has lived through.

She looks back at growing up in the public eye from the age of 10: the comments on her body as a teenager, the innocence she says she lost by 15, and the mom who kept her grounded. She opens up about divorce, co-parenting, and why a kind partner was so hard to accept.

And she talks about being the peacemaker when her parents split up, the father she wishes would show up, and why some of the hardest relationships are in your own family.

Learn why she calls it a raw nerve. And learn what she still hopes for the person she grew up with.
